blind.why: Mid-fight at 1280x720 (1280_s1/06-my-hit vs t1_020). Our hit X, the red-bordered 'You + Lumen > Tango' feed row and the '+$300 TAG' delta all read instantly. CS2 still looks more premium: thin unboxed elements, a centred vitals/ammo rail and small pips. Our chunky pip tiles and boxed timer feel heavier.

Calm live frame (1280_s1/05-roam-24.2 vs t1_022). Ours is clean and legible, close to CS2's layout. CS2 is calmer and more cohesive. Our topbar is the loudest thing on screen (32 px saturated tiles against CS2's ~20 px).
Radar crop 320x240 at the same scale. Ours is crisp and high-contrast: A/B badges, outlined dots, view cone, death X and a clear callout. It is genuinely more useful than CS2's soft disc.
Bottom strip crop. CS2's centred armour/HP rail and award log beat our sparse bottom-left/right corners.
Topbar plus feed crop. Our timer, score, 'N vs N' and feed are more legible. This was close to a coin-flip.

biggest_gap: REGRESSION: the new killcam leaves you spectating the ENEMY who tagged you for the rest of the round, which also leaks enemy positions. Reproduced 3 of 3 times in real bot matches: ?test=1&seed=1&match=1&phase=live at 1280x720 (Orbit tags you at t=42 and match.spectating stays 'Orbit' (tide) until round end at t=105 while Ember teammate Kestrel is alive; shots/critic-hud-r4/1280_s1/12-16), seed=2 at 1920x1080 (stuck on Halo9 with 3 teammates alive, 1920_s2/07-08), and seed=3 (stuck on Zed, t2_1280_s3/07). Cause: index.js calls ctx.player.spectate(killer) for the killcam. That emits 'spectate', and the match/flow.js listener copies it into M.spectating. Your 'restore match.spectating' then restores the killer, and spectateTick never moves on because he is alive. The result: the radar centres on the enemy and shows his teammates (cyan arrows), the vitals and ammo show his numbers, and at round end '+$3,250 Round win' shows the ENEMY's economy. CS2 never lets you spectate an enemy while a teammate lives. Fix: remember the pre-killcam teammate target, or guard the emit with match._specGuard, and after 1.5 s go to match.cycleSpectate or nextAlive among teammates.
other_gaps: The topbar is the heaviest element on screen. Ten saturated 32 px pip tiles (720p) plus a boxed timer pull the eye from the crosshair. CS2 uses ~20 px desaturated avatars with a thin underline.

The crosshair barely reacts to a spray. With the Arc held 0.75 s (8 shots, 1280x720, t2_1280_s3/02-04, xhair_strip.png) the inner gap only grows from ~15 px to ~19 px (crosshairSpread 0.057 to 0.091), and the arms vanish into the muzzle-smoke puff. Either scale the gap to the real recoil and bloom, or add a dark outline that survives smoke.
Round-end banner: the '★ MVP <NAME>' line sits on the banner's bottom rule, and the rule strikes through the text (1280_s1/16-round-end, gal-banner-win.png).
Buy phase still stacks a notice ('LUMEN PICKED UP THE BEACON') directly above the full-width ROUND 2 banner (1280_s1/18-buy-phase). The launch note says notices are suppressed in buy/freeze.
The bottom corners are sparse next to CS2's centred vitals rail. There is no low-HP or recent-damage tick on the HP bar, and no event log of awards.
Buy-menu weapon icons are blocky first-pass silhouettes (Halo/Lance/Storm read as the same rifle shape).
bugs: Spectating sticks on the enemy killer after the killcam for the whole round, with teammates alive (3/3 seeds). The radar, vitals, ammo and round-end money delta show enemy data.
The MVP subtitle is struck through by the round-banner border line.
strengths: The radar is crisp and genuinely useful (badges, cone, death X, callouts).
The killcam beat on the killer itself works and the crosshair is drawn while spectating.
The merged spectator panel and the left recap strip keep the centre clear.
The buy menu is readable: price colours, 30% dim for unaffordable items, outlined column, loadout panel.
Damage arcs hug the crosshair and read well.
No console errors. hud.update median 0.3-0.4 ms (machine load ~70; p95 2-8 ms and a one-off multi-second spike measured under that load).
